name: DateRangePicker
label: Date range picker
description: An inline calendar for choosing a range of days, one or two months wide, with presets.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen range (controlled). Pair with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The range it starts with (uncontrolled).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the range as the reader chooses it: once with only `start` after the first day, then with both.

props.name: months
props.description: How many months show side by side, 1 or 2. Two stack when the picker is narrow. Defaults to 2.

props.name: min
props.description: The first day that can be chosen (YYYY-MM-DD).

props.name: max
props.description: The last day that can be chosen (YYYY-MM-DD).

props.name: isDateDisabled
props.description: Mark further days unavailable: weekends, holidays, booked nights. Given each day as a `YYYY-MM-DD` string. A range may not span one.

props.name: minLength
props.description: The fewest days a range may hold, counting both ends.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: The most days a range may hold, counting both ends.

props.name: presets
props.description: Ranges the reader can pick in one press, shown above the calendar: "Last 7 days", "This quarter".

props.name: presetsLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the presets. Defaults to "Presets".

props.name: size
props.description: Component size

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the picker is disabled

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name: the form receives `<name>[start]` and `<name>[end]` as `YYYY-MM-DD` through hidden inputs.

props.name: previousLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the previous-month button.

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the next-month button.

props.name: monthLabel
props.description: The month heading, given the first day of a month in view. Defaults to the month name and the year in `locale`.

props.name: dayLabel
props.description: A day button's accessible name, given its date and where it sits in the range. Defaults to the full date in `locale`, followed by the matching position label.

props.name: rangeStartLabel
props.description: Said after the first day of the range. Defaults to "start of range".

props.name: rangeEndLabel
props.description: Said after the last day of the range. Defaults to "end of range".

props.name: inRangeLabel
props.description: Said after a day inside the range. Defaults to "in range".

props.name: weekdayLabels
props.description: The visible weekday headers: seven entries, Sunday first. Defaults as in DatePicker.

props.name: weekdayNames
props.description: The weekday headers' spoken names: seven entries, Sunday first. Defaults to the weekday names in `locale`.

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale the calendar is written and laid out in. Defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider's, else `en-US`.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: The first column of the grid, 0 (Sunday) to 6 (Saturday). Defaults to the first day of the week in `locale`.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes
